description: This Java source file defines the ChromeNativeTestActivity class, which extends ChromiumActivity. It manages loading native libraries, setting up test environments, and running tests either on a new thread or after a delay, primarily for testing Chromium on Android.

classes.name: ChromeNativeTestActivity
classes.description: An activity class that loads native libraries and runs tests for Chromium on Android.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the native library, and schedules test execution.
